title: Dynamics 365 ERP MCP: semantic index to shorten agent tool-call sequences
summary: The roadmap facts, billing, security descriptions and both client-allowlist controls are supported. The cited Microsoft pages opened successfully; the only correction is to raise the action rating for the imminent automatic rollout.

claims.claim: The record lists Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) and Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app"]

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.claim: The general availability target is December CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The preview target is October CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "October CY2026"

claims.claim: The release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) is the only listed cloud, without an explicit exclusion of government clouds.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Web is the only listed platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The planned enhancement uses a semantic index of available menu items, entities and actions.
claims.quote: a semantic index of the available menu items, entities, and actions.

claims.claim: The planned enhancement provides a single point of entry for MCP tools.
claims.quote: with a single point of entry for MCP tools

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The enhancement aims to select optimal tool sequences instead of orchestration sequences that can contain unnecessary calls.
claims.quote: The orchestration can select the tool execution sequence and can include more tool calls than are required.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The change is enabled automatically for admins, makers and marketers, supporting defaultState on rather than an opt-in.
claims.quote: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

claims.claim: The Dynamics 365 ERP Model Context Protocol server lets agents work with finance and operations data and business logic.
claims.quote: The Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server provides a dynamic framework for agents to perform data operations and access the business logic of finance and operations apps.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the semantic-index and single-entry-point enhancement.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dynamics 365" "MCP" "semantic index"; "ERP MCP" "single point of entry"; opened copilot-mcp, mcp-security, mcp-foundry and erp-analytics-mcp-overview. No description of this enhancement found.

claims.claim: The roadmap's more-information link points to the ERP Analytics MCP overview.
claims.quote: "moreInfoLink": "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-analytics/erp-analytics-mcp-overview"

claims.claim: The linked page describes the separate ERP Analytics MCP server for Business performance analytics.
claims.quote: The ERP Analytics MCP server works alongside the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server

claims.claim: ERP Analytics MCP is a preview.
claims.quote: This feature is a preview feature.

claims.claim: Today's dynamic ERP MCP server has data, form and action tool categories.
claims.quote: The Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server provides three categories of tools for working with the data and business logic of finance and operations apps

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: form_find_menu_item is a documented menu-item lookup tool.
claims.quote: | `form_find_menu_item` | Find a menu item |

claims.claim: data_find_entity_type is a documented entity-type lookup tool.
claims.quote: | `data_find_entity_type` | Find OData entity types.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate administrative switch for the semantic-index enhancement is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 ERP MCP semantic index optimal tool execution single entry point enable feature management version licensing; opened copilot-mcp and mcp-foundry. Only the server-wide Feature management switch was documented.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The current server returns only menu items accessible to the authenticated user's security role.
claims.quote: when the agent calls the `form_find_menu_item` tool, it returns only menu items to which that security role has access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The current server filters entities to those accessible to the user context's security role.
claims.quote: the entities returned in the response to the `data_find_entity_type` tool and APIs returned in the response to the `api_find_actions` tool only include objects to which the security role for the user context has access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The current server filters actions to those accessible to the user's security role.
claims.quote: When the view model for a form is returned to the agent, it includes only data, fields, and actions to which the user role has access.

claims.claim: The system rejects explicit calls to actions or objects outside the user's role.
claims.quote: The system rejects any explicit calls to actions or objects to which the user role doesn't have access.

claims.claim: Microsoft says the MCP server does not store customer data.
claims.quote: It returns results to the calling client for the duration of the request, but doesn't store customer data.

claims.claim: Storage by the planned semantic index is not separately described.
claims.quote: Searched: Dynamics 365 ERP MCP semantic index customer data stored settings billing credits; "Dynamics 365" "MCP" "semantic index". Opened mcp-security and copilot-mcp; neither describes storage by the planned index.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Operations run under the authenticated identity and its finance and operations security context.
claims.quote: Operations run under the authenticated user's identity and security context in finance and operations apps.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Finance and operations security enforces authorization for MCP requests.
claims.quote: Finance and operations security, not the MCP server, enforces authorization.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Allowed MCP clients controls which agent clients can connect to the ERP MCP server.
claims.quote: Use the Allowed MCP clients configuration to control which agent clients can connect to the MCP server.

claims.claim: The server exposes a data tool that creates records.
claims.quote: | `data_create_entities` | Create data records by using OData.

claims.claim: The server exposes a data tool that updates records.
claims.quote: | `data_update_entities` | Update data records by using OData. |

claims.claim: The server exposes a data tool that deletes records.
claims.quote: | `data_delete_entities` | Delete data records by using OData. |

claims.claim: The server exposes a form tool that saves forms.
claims.quote: | `form_save_form` | Saves form |

claims.claim: Microsoft support does not guarantee assistance for errors when this server is added to the Copilot for finance and operations apps agent.
claims.quote: Microsoft support doesn't guarantee assistance for resolving errors or problems for these scenarios.

claims.claim: ERP MCP usage has agent orchestration and MCP server execution cost components.
claims.quote: When you use the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server in an agent, you incur two types of costs: 1. The agent orchestration cost (LLM cost), and 2. The MCP server execution cost (tool calls to the server).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Studio bills the tool calls as Agent Action at a fixed rate per call.
claims.quote: When you use the MCP server in Copilot Studio, the tool calls align with the Agent Action feature, which bills at a fixed rate per tool call.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Studio's Agent Action rate covers orchestration and execution without an incremental server execution charge.
claims.quote: In Copilot Studio, billing for the Agent Action feature includes both the LLM cost for orchestration and the execution of the MCP server.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: On other agent clients, the standard execution rate is 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call.
claims.quote: For agents built on other agent clients, usage of the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server incurs a cost of one copilot credit per 10 tool calls to the server (or 0.1 credits per tool call).

claims.claim: Other agent clients separately charge for LLM orchestration at their own rates.
claims.quote: The cost for the LLM orchestration is a separate charge by the agent client for token consumption, based on the rates of that client.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Dynamics 365 Finance Premium users are exempt from tool execution billing on clients other than Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: The following premium licenses are exempt from the tool execution billing for agents built on clients other than Copilot Studio. ... Dynamics 365 Finance Premium

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Premium users receive the same non-Copilot-Studio execution exemption.
claims.quote: The following premium licenses are exempt from the tool execution billing for agents built on clients other than Copilot Studio. ... Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Premium

claims.claim: The ERP MCP page says Copilot Studio agent usage is included in the Microsoft Copilot license.
claims.quote: For Copilot Studio agents, agent usage is included in the Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.claim: Copilot USL users' Copilot Studio agent calls under their authenticated identity incur no additional ERP MCP credit consumption.
claims.quote: Business to Employee usage of Copilot Studio agents is included in the Copilot USL when the user of that agent is licensed with Copilot and the agent operates by using the authenticated Copilot USL user's identity.

claims.claim: Mixed describes the published combination of metered usage and license-based inclusions or exemptions.
claims.quote: Tool execution cost ... Billed at 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call ... The following premium licenses are exempt from the tool execution billing for agents built on clients other than Copilot Studio.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A license or rate specific to the semantic-index enhancement has not been published, and the roadmap announces no billing change.
claims.quote: Searched: "ERP MCP" "optimal tool" feature enable licensing version; Dynamics 365 ERP MCP semantic index customer data stored settings billing credits. Read the roadmap record and copilot-mcp licensing; no enhancement-specific entitlement or rate found.

claims.claim: The current server requires at least 10.0.47, 10.0.46 PQU-2 or 10.0.45 PQU-7.
claims.quote: The product version of Dynamics 365 finance and operations apps must be at least: 10.0.47; 10.0.46 PQU-2; 10.0.45 PQU-7

claims.claim: Tier 2 or above environments are supported.
claims.quote: Your environment is Tier 2 or above, or a Unified Developer Environment.

claims.claim: A Unified Developer Environment is also supported.
claims.quote: Your environment is Tier 2 or above, or a Unified Developer Environment.

claims.claim: Cloud Hosted Environments are not supported.
claims.quote: The MCP server isn't supported on Cloud Hosted Environments (CHE).

claims.claim: A required application version specific to this enhancement is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "ERP MCP" "optimal tool" feature enable licensing version; Dynamics 365 ERP MCP semantic index optimal tool execution single entry point enable feature management version licensing. Read copilot-mcp prerequisites; no version for this enhancement found.

claims.claim: The finance and operations client path is System administration > Setup > Allowed MCP clients > New > Allowed.
claims.quote: Go to System administration > Setup > Allowed MCP clients ... Select New on the action ribbon. ... Allowed | true

claims.claim: dataverse mcp allow <appId> --erp allows the application on the linked Finance and Operations instance.
claims.quote: dataverse mcp allow <appId> [options] ... --erp | Allow the application on the linked Finance and Operations instance instead of Dataverse.

claims.claim: Dataverse CLI is preview.
claims.quote: Dataverse CLI reference (preview) ... This is a preview feature.

claims.claim: The command uses the current profile's environment and targets its linked Finance and Operations instance with --erp.
claims.quote: Ensure that a Microsoft Entra application is in the Dataverse MCP allowed clients list for the current profile's environment. ... --erp | Allow the application on the linked Finance and Operations instance instead of Dataverse.

claims.claim: appId takes the application's client ID as a GUID.
claims.quote: The <appId> argument is the application (client) ID to allow, as a GUID.

claims.claim: The CLI operation requires Dataverse admin permissions on the target environment.
claims.quote: The authenticated user must have Dataverse admin permissions on the target environment.

claims.claim: A new Allowed MCP clients record supplies Name and ClientId and sets Allowed to true.
claims.quote: Name | Provide a name for your MCP connection ... ClientId | The Application (client) ID value of your new registered app ... Allowed | true

claims.claim: Changing an agent user's access means updating the same roles, duties, privileges and policies used for other finance and operations channels.
claims.quote: If administrators want to change what a user can access or modify through the MCP server, they should update the same security roles, duties, privileges, and policies that they use for other finance and operations channels.

claims.claim: The server-wide Dynamics 365 ERP Model Context Protocol server feature is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Enable the Dynamics 365 ERP Model Context Protocol server feature in Feature Management if not already enabled. The MCP server is enabled by default.

claims.claim: Feature management manages the server-wide feature, rather than a documented separate semantic-index control.
claims.quote: Enable the Dynamics 365 ERP Model Context Protocol server feature in Feature Management if not already enabled.

claims.claim: Variable cost correctly identifies the documented Copilot Credits tool-call meter; a change in charged calls changes execution consumption.
claims.quote: Tool execution cost ... Billed at 0.1 Copilot Credits per tool call

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits the briefing's automatic December rollout and metered-cost assessment on the November 27 run.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; targetDate: "December CY2026"; cost: "variable"; "the change is enabled automatically"; "run your key ERP agent scenarios before and after it reaches your environment"
claims.fix: Change action from prepare to act-now: the December CY2026 target is within 60 days of November 27, the change is automatic, and the briefing identifies metered spend and pre-rollout scenario testing.
